test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 1 June 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: How many Primary Health Centres are there in rural areas of India as per 31st March 2020 data?
solution:
The correct answer is __**30813**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Primary Health Centres (PHCs)**

 
 
• The **fundamental structural and operational component of public health services **in developing nations is the **Primary Healthcare Center (PHC)**.
 
• PHCs were **created to provide people with primary healthcare that is easily accessible, reasonably priced, and readily available**, in accordance with the **Alma Ata Declaration of 1978 by the World Health Organization (WHO) **member countries.
 
• Primary Health Centers (PHC) are established** under the National Health Mission (NHM)** to serve** 20,000 people in mountainous, tribal, and desert areas** and** 30,000 **people in **rural areas**.
 
• According to the **Rural Health Statistics 2019–20**, there were** 5,895 urban PHCs** and** 30,813 rural PHCs** operating in the nation as of March 31, 2020.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **PHCs** are the** principal first-line** providers of** primary healthcare in South Asia**.
 
• For outreach services including **immunisation, basic curative treatment, maternity and child health services, and preventative services, each PHC has five or six sub-centres staffed by health workers**.
 
• There are currently** 23,109 PHCs in India**.
 
• **National Health Mission**
 
 
• Under the **National Health Mission (NHM)**, States are given financial assistance to improve their p**ublic health systems, notably by building new or upgrading existing facilities**.
 
• **Infrastructure spending** is allowed under **NHM in high-priority states for up to 33 per cent** and in **other States up to 25 per cent**.
